verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ አድዋሊሆሙ ፡ ለ[ኤዶማውያን ፡] እምነ ፡ ገዳም ፡
                  ዘ[ፂን] ፡ እስከ ፡ ቃዴስ ፡ መንገለ ፡ አዜብ ።
verses.translation: And the borders of the tribe of Juda according to their families were from the borders of Idumea from the wilderness of Sin, as far as Cades southward.

translations.lxx: And the borders of the tribe of Juda according to their families were from the borders of Idumea from the wilderness of Sin, as far as Cades southward.
translations.kjv: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
translations.ron: Moşia căzută la sorţi pentru seminţia fiilor lui Iuda, după familiile lor, se întindea de la hotarele lui Edom din miazăzi şi de la pustiul Sin până la Cadeş, spre răsărit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια φυλῆς Ἰούδα κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τῶν ὁρίων τῆς Ἰδουμαίας ἀπὸ τῆς ἐρήμου Σὶν ἕως Κάδης πρὸς Λίβα.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሊቦስ ፡ እስከ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ኅብር ፡ ዘባሕረ ፡ አሊቄ ፡ እምነ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ ትወስድ
                  ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሊባ ።
verses.translation: And their borders were from the south as far as a part of the salt sea from the high country that extends southward.

translations.lxx: And their borders were from the south as far as a part of the salt sea from the high country that extends southward.
translations.kjv: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
translations.ron: Astfel hotarul lor de miazăzi porneşte de la Marea Sărată, de unde pleacă un golf al ei spre miazăzi,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτῶν τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ Λιβὸς ἕως μέρους θαλάσσης τῆς ἁλυκῆς ἀπὸ τῆς λοφιᾶς τῆς φερούσης ἐπὶ Λίβα.

verses.geez:
ወተሐውር ፡ ቅድመ ፡ አቅራቢን ፡ ወትወፅእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሴናቀ ፡ ወተዐርግ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሊ[ቦ]ስ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቃዴስ ፡ በርኔ
                  ፡ ወትወፅእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አስሮን ፡ ወተዐርግ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሰራዳ ፡ ወትወፅእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ዐረበ ፡ ቃዴስ ።
verses.translation: And they proceed before the ascent of Acrabin, and go out round Sena, and go up from the south to Cades Barne; and go out to Asoron, and proceed up to Sarada, and go out by the way that is west of Cades.

translations.lxx: And they proceed before the ascent of Acrabin, and go out round Sena, and go up from the south to Cades Barne; and go out to Asoron, and proceed up to Sarada, and go out by the way that is west of Cades.
translations.kjv: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
translations.ron: Merge spre înălţimea Acravimului, trece prin pustiul Sin şi, ridicându-se dinspre miazăzi către Cadeş-Barnea, merge pe la Heţron şi, ajungând la Adar, trece pe partea dinspre apus a Cadeşului şi se întoarce spre Carcaa;
translations.grk: Καὶ διαπορεύεται ἀπέναντι τῆς προσαναβάσεως Ἀκραβίν· καὶ ἐκπεριπορεύεται Σενὰ, καὶ ἀναβαίνει ἀπὸ Λιβὸς ἐπὶ Κάδης Βαρνῆ· καὶ ἐκπορεύεται Ἀσωρὼν, καὶ προσαναβαίνει εἰς Σάραδα· καὶ ἐκπορεύεται τὴν κατὰ δυσμὰς Κάδης,

verses.geez:
ወተሐውር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሴልሞናን ፡ ወትወፅእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ሞጻእቱ ፡ ለደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡
                  ባሕር ፡ ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ አዜብ ።
verses.translation: And they go out to Selmona, and issue at the valley of Egypt; and the termination of its boundaries shall be at the sea: these are their boundaries southward.

translations.lxx: And they go out to Selmona, and issue at the valley of Egypt; and the termination of its boundaries shall be at the sea: these are their boundaries southward.
translations.kjv: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
translations.ron: Trece apoi prin Aţmon şi urmează înainte până la râul Egiptului şi apoi capătul acestui hotar atinge marea. Acesta va fi hotarul vostru de miazăzi.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐκπορεύεται ἐπὶ Σελμωνὰν, καὶ διεκβάλλει ἕως φάραγγος Αἰγύπτου· καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος τῶν ὁρίων ἐπὶ τὴν θάλασσαν· τοῦτό ἐστιν αὐτῶν ὅρια ἀπὸ Λιβός.

verses.geez:
ወደወሎሙ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ጽባሕ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ አሊቄ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፤ ወደወሎሙ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ መስዕ ፡ እምነ
                  ፡ ፍኖት ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወእምነ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ኅብር ፡ ዘዮርዳንስ ።
verses.translation: And their boundaries eastward are all the salt sea as far as Jordan; and their borders from the north, and from the border of the sea, and from part of Jordan—

translations.lxx: And their boundaries eastward are all the salt sea as far as Jordan; and their borders from the north, and from the border of the sea, and from part of Jordan—
translations.kjv: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
translations.ron: Hotarul de răsărit e toată Marea Sărată până la gurile Iordanului. Iar apoi hotarul de miazănoapte pleacă din golful mării de la gurile Iordanului;
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰ ὅρια ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν πᾶσα ἡ θάλασσα ἡ ἁλυκὴ ἕως τοῦ Ἰορδάνου. Καὶ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Βοῤῥᾶ, καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς λοφιᾶς τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ μέρους τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

verses.geez:
ወየዐርግ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ግላዓም ፡ ወየኀልፍ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ቦራ ፡ ወየዐርግ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሊቶንቤዎን ፡
                  ዘወልደ ፡ ሮቤል ።
verses.translation: the borders go up to Bæthaglaam, and they go along from the north to Bætharaba, and the borders go on up to the stone of Bæon the son of Ruben.

translations.lxx: the borders go up to Bæthaglaam, and they go along from the north to Bætharaba, and the borders go on up to the stone of Bæon the son of Ruben.
translations.kjv: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
translations.ron: De aici se ridică spre Bet-Hogla. Trece pe la miazănoapte de Bet-Araba şi merge în sus până la piatra lui Bohan, fiul lui Ruben;
translations.grk: Ἐπιβαίνει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ Βαιθαγλαάμ· καὶ παραπορεύεται ἀπὸ Βοῤῥᾶ ἐπὶ Βαιθάραβα, καὶ προσαναβαίνει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ λίθον Βαιὼν υἱοῦ Ῥουβήν·

verses.geez:
ወየዐርግ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ራብዕቱ ፡ ለቈላተ ፡ አኮር ፡ ወይወርድ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ገልገል ፡ እንተ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ማዕዶተ
                  ፡ አደሚን ፡ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡ አዜቡ ፡ ለቈላት ፡ ወታወፅእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነቅዐ ፡ ማየ ፡ ሄልዩ ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ሞጻእቱ ፡
                  ነቅዐ ፡ ሮጌል ።
verses.translation: And the borders continue on to the fourth part of the valley of Achor, and go down to Galgal, which is before the approach of Adammin, which is southward in the valley, and terminate at the water of the fountain of the sun; and their going forth shall be the fountain of Rogel.

translations.lxx: And the borders continue on to the fourth part of the valley of Achor, and go down to Galgal, which is before the approach of Adammin, which is southward in the valley, and terminate at the water of the fountain of the sun; and their going forth shall be the fountain of Rogel.
translations.kjv: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
translations.ron: Apoi hotarul se urcă spre Debir, din valea Acor şi se îndreaptă spre miazănoapte către Ghilgal, care se află în faţa Adumimului, pe partea de miazăzi a râului; apoi trece pe la apele En-Şemeş şi se prelungeşte până la En-Roghel.
translations.grk: Καὶ προσαναβαίνει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ τὸ τέταρτον τῆς φάραγγος Ἀχὼρ, καὶ καταβαίνει ἐπὶ Γαλγὰλ, ἥ ἐστιν ἀπέναντι τῆς προσβάσεως Ἀδαμμὶν, ἥ ἐστι κατὰ Λίβα τῇ φάραγγι, καὶ διεκβάλλεῖ ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ ἡλίου· καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος πηγὴ Ῥωγήλ·

verses.geez:
ወየዐርግ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ እንተ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኤኖ[ም] ፡ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡ አዜባ ፡ ለኢያቡስ ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡
                  አያሩሳሌም ፡ ወያወፅእ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ደብር ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ ኤኖም ፡ ዘኀበ ፡ ባሕር ፡ እንተ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ኅብር ፡ ዘምድረ ፡ ረፋይን ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ መስዕ ።
verses.translation: And the borders go up to the valley of Ennom, behind Jebus southward; this is Jerusalem: and the borders terminate at the top of the mountain, which is before the valley of Ennom toward the sea, which is by the side of the land of Raphain northward.

translations.lxx: And the borders go up to the valley of Ennom, behind Jebus southward; this is Jerusalem: and the borders terminate at the top of the mountain, which is before the valley of Ennom toward the sea, which is by the side of the land of Raphain northward.
translations.kjv: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
translations.ron: De aici hotarul merge în sus spre valea Ben-Hinom, pe partea de miazăzi de Iebus, care este Ierusalimul; apoi hotarul se ridică spre vârful muntelui, care este spre apus, în faţa văii Hinom, la marginea văii Refaim, la miazănoapte.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀναβαίνει τὰ ὅρια εἰς φάραγγα Ἐννὸμ, ἐπὶ νώτου τοῦ Ἰεβοῦις ἀπὸ Λιβός· αὕτη ἐστιν Ἱερουσαλήμ· καὶ διεκβάλλει τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ κορυφὴν ὄρους, ἥ ἐστι κατὰ πρόσωπον φάραγγος Ἐννὸμ πρὸς θαλάσσης, ἥ ἐστιν ἐκ μέρους γῆς Ῥαφαῒν ἐπὶ βοῤῥᾶ·

verses.geez:
ወይወስድ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ርእሰ ፡ ደብር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነቅዐ ፡ ማይ ፡ ዘነፍቶ ፡ ወያበጽሕ ፡ ውስተ ፡
                  ደብረ ፡ ኤፍ[ሮን] ፡ ወይወስድ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ [በዓል ፡] እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ኢያሪን ።
verses.translation: And the border going forth from the top of the mountain terminates at the fountain of the water of Naphtho, and terminates at mount Ephron; and the border will lead to Baal; this is the city of Jarim.

translations.lxx: And the border going forth from the top of the mountain terminates at the fountain of the water of Naphtho, and terminates at mount Ephron; and the border will lead to Baal; this is the city of Jarim.
translations.kjv: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
translations.ron: Din vârful muntelui, hotarul se îndreaptă spre izvorul apelor Neftoah şi merge spre cetăţile din muntele Efron; apoi hotarul coteşte spre Baala, care e Chiriat-Iearimul;
translations.grk: Καὶ διεκβάλλει τὸ ὅριον ἀπὸ κορυφῆς τοῦ ὄρους ἐπὶ πηγὴν ὕδατος Ναφθὼ, καὶ διεκβάλλει εἰς τὸ ὄρος Ἐφρών· καὶ ἄξει τὸ ὅριον εἰς Βαάλ· αὕτη ἐστὶ πόλις Ἰαρίμ.

verses.geez:
ወየኀልፍ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ በዓል ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወየኀልፍ ፡ እንተ ፡ ደወለ ፡ አሳሬቱስ ፡ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡
                  አዜባ ፡ ለሀገረ ፡ ኢያሪም ፡ ወመስዓ ፡ ለከሰሎን ፡ ወይወርድ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ኤልዩ ፡ ወየኀልፍ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሊባ ።
verses.translation: And the border will go round from Baal to the sea, and will go on to the mount of Assar behind the city of Jarin northwards; this is Chaslon: and it will come down to the city of the Sun, and will go on to the south.

translations.lxx: And the border will go round from Baal to the sea, and will go on to the mount of Assar behind the city of Jarin northwards; this is Chaslon: and it will come down to the city of the Sun, and will go on to the south.
translations.kjv: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Bethshemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
translations.ron: După aceea hotarul se întoarce de la Baala spre mare şi merge spre muntele Seir, trece pe partea de miazănoapte a muntelui Iearim, care e Chesalonul şi, pogorându-se către Bet-Şemeş, trece prin Timna;
translations.grk: Καὶ περιελεύσεται ὅριον ἀπὸ Βαὰλ ἐπὶ θάλασσαν, καὶ παρελεύσεται εἰς ὄρος Ἀσσὰρ ἐπὶ νώτου πόλιν Ἰαρὶν ἀπὸ Βοῤῥᾶ· αὕτη ἐστὶ Χασλών· καὶ καταβήσεται ἐπὶ πόλιν ἡλίου, καὶ παρελεύσεται ἐπὶ Λίβα·

verses.geez:
ወያወፅእ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አዜባ ፡ ለዐቃሮን ፡ ወይገብእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ መስዕ ፡ ወያወፅእ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ሶቆት
                  ፡ ወየኀልፍ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ አዜብ ፡ ወያወፅእ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ሌብና ፡ ወይከውን ፡ ሞፃእቱ ፡ ለደወሎሙ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፤
                  ወደወሎሙኒ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ባሕር ፡ ዐቢይ ፡ ወሰኖሙ ።
verses.translation: And the border terminates behind Accaron northward, and the borders will terminate at Socchoth, and the borders will go on to the south, and will terminate at Lebna, and the issue of the borders will be at the sea; and their borders shall be toward the sea, the great sea shall be the boundary.

translations.lxx: And the border terminates behind Accaron northward, and the borders will terminate at Socchoth, and the borders will go on to the south, and will terminate at Lebna, and the issue of the borders will be at the sea; and their borders shall be toward the sea, the great sea shall be the boundary.
translations.kjv: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
translations.ron: De aici hotarul merge pe partea de miazănoapte a Ecronului şi se întoarce spre Şicron, trece prin muntele Baala şi ajunge până la Iabneel şi apoi se termină hotarul la mare. Hotarul de la apus îl formează Marea cea Mare.
translations.grk: Καὶ διεκβάλλει τὸ ὅριον κατὰ νώτου Ἀκκαρὼν ἐπὶ βοῤῥᾶν, καὶ διεκβαλεῖ τὰ ὅρια εἰς Σοκχὼθ, καὶ παρελεύσεται ὅρια ἐπὶ Λίβα, καὶ διεκβαλεῖ ἐπὶ Λεβνὰ, καὶ ἔσται ἡ διέξοδος τῶν ὁρίων ἐπὶ θάλασσαν·

verses.geez: ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ዘአውዶሙ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ።
verses.translation: These are the borders of the children of Juda round about according to their families.

translations.lxx: These are the borders of the children of Juda round about according to their families.
translations.kjv: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
translations.ron: Acesta este hotarul pământului fiilor lui Iuda, după familiile lor, din toate părţile.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἀπὸ θαλάσσης, ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη ὁριεῖ. Ταῦτα τὰ ὅρια υἱῶν Ἰούδα κύκλῳ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወለካሌብ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዬፎኔ ፡ ወሀቦ ፡ መክፈልቶ ፡ በማእከሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ በትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወወሀቦ
                  ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ አ[ር]ቦቅ ፡ ደብረ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ኤናቅ ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኬብሮን ።
verses.translation: And to Chaleb the son of Jephone he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Juda by the command of God; and Joshua gave him the city of Arboc the metropolis of Enac; this is Chebron.

translations.lxx: And to Chaleb the son of Jephone he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Juda by the command of God; and Joshua gave him the city of Arboc the metropolis of Enac; this is Chebron.
translations.kjv: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
translations.ron: Lui Caleb, fiul lui Iefone, i-a dat Iosua parte intre fiii lui Iuda, cum poruncise Domnul lui Iosua şi i-a dat Iosua Chiriat-Arba a tatălui lui Enac, care este Hebronul.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ Χάλεβ υἱῷ Ἰεφονῆ ἔδωκε μερίδα ἐν μέσῳ υἱῶν Ἰούδα διὰ προστάγματος τοῦ Θεοῦ· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς τὴν πόλιν Ἀρβὸκ μητρόπολιν Ἐνάκ· αὕτη ἐστὶ Χεβρών.

verses.geez:
ወሠረዎሙ ፡ እምህየ ፡ ካሌብ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዬፎኔ ፡ ለሠለስቲሆሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኤናቅ ፡ ለ[ሡ]ሲ ፡ ወለጠ[ለ]ሚ ፡ ወለአኪማ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Chaleb the son of Jephone destroyed thence the three sons of Enac, Susi, and Tholami, and Achima.

translations.lxx: And Chaleb the son of Jephone destroyed thence the three sons of Enac, Susi, and Tholami, and Achima.
translations.kjv: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
translations.ron: Însă Caleb, fiul lui Iefone, a alungat de acolo pe cei trei fii ai lui Enac: pe Şeşai, pe Ahiman şi pe Talmai, copiii lui Enac.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξωλόθρευσεν ἐκεῖθεν Χάλεβ υἱὸς Ἰεφονὴ τοὺς τρεῖς υἱοὺς Ἐνὰκ, τὸν Σουσὶ καὶ Θολαμὶ καὶ τὸν Ἀχιμᾶ.

verses.geez:
ወዐርገ ፡ እምህየ ፡ ካሌብ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዳቢር ፡ ወስማ ፡ ለዳቢር ፡ ቀዲሙ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ መጽሐፍ
                  ።
verses.translation: And Chaleb went up thence to the inhabitants of Dabir; and the name of Dabir before was the city of Letters.

translations.lxx: And Chaleb went up thence to the inhabitants of Dabir; and the name of Dabir before was the city of Letters.
translations.kjv: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
translations.ron: De aici Caleb a pornit asupra locuitorilor Debirului; numele Debirului era mai înainte Chiriat-Sefer.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβη ἐκεῖθεν Χάλεβ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δαβίρ· τὸ δὲ ὄνομα Δαβὶρ ἦν τὸ πρότερον πόλις Γραμμάτων.

verses.geez:
ወይቤ ፡ ካሌብ ፡ ዘነሥኣ ፡ ወቀተላ ፡ ለሀገረ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ወአስተጋብኣ ፡ እሁቦ ፡ አ[ስ]ካ ፡ ወለትየ ፡ ትኵኖ ፡
                  ብእሲተ ።
verses.translation: And Chaleb said, Whosoever shall take and destroy the city of Letters, and master it, to him will I give my daughter Ascha to wife.

translations.lxx: And Chaleb said, Whosoever shall take and destroy the city of Letters, and master it, to him will I give my daughter Ascha to wife.
translations.kjv: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Caleb: "Cel ce va bate Chiriat-Seferul şi-l va lua, aceluia îi voi da pe Acsa, fiica mea, de femeie".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Χάλεβ, ὃς ἂν λάβῃ καὶ ἐκκόψῃ τὴν πόλιν τῶν Γραμμάτων καὶ κυριεύσῃ αὐτῆς, δώσω αὐτῷ τὴν Ἀσχὰν θυγατέρα μου εἰς γυναῖκα.

verses.geez: ወነሥኣ ፡ ጎቶንዬል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ቄኔዝ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለካሌብ ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ አ[ስ]ካ ፡ ወለቶ ፡ ትኵኖ ፡ ብእሲተ ።
verses.translation: And Gothoniel the son of Chenez the brother of Chaleb took it; and he gave him Ascha his daughter to wife.

translations.lxx: And Gothoniel the son of Chenez the brother of Chaleb took it; and he gave him Ascha his daughter to wife.
translations.kjv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
translations.ron: Şi l-a luat Otniel cel tânăr, fiul lui Chenaz, fratele lui Caleb şi i-a dat Caleb de femeie pe Acsa, fiica sa.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν Γοθονιὴλ υἱὸς Χενὲζ ἀδελφοῦ Χάλεβ· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν Ἀσχὰν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ለሐዊር ፡ ተማከረቶ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብል ፡ እስአሎ ፡ ለአቡየ ፡ ገራህተ ፡ ወጸርኀት ፡ በዲበ ፡ አድግ ፡
                  ወይቤላ ፡ ካሌብ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ኮንኪ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass as she went out that she counselled him, saying, I will ask of my father a field; and she cried from off her ass; and Chaleb said to her, What is it?

translations.lxx: And it came to pass as she went out that she counselled him, saying, I will ask of my father a field; and she cried from off her ass; and Chaleb said to her, What is it?
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
translations.ron: Dar când a trebuit să plece, a fost învăţată să ceară de la tatăl său o ţarină. Şi când a descălecat ea de pe asin, Caleb i-a zis: "Ce vrei?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐκπορεύέσθαι αὐτὴν καὶ συνέβουλεύσατο αὐτῷ, λέγουσα, αἰτήσομαι τὸν πατέρα μου ἀγρόν· καὶ ἐβόησεν ἐκ τοῦ ὄνου· καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Χάλεβ, τί ἐστί σοι;

verses.geez:
ወትቤሎ ፡ ሀበኒ ፡ በረከተ ፡ እስመ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ናጌ[ብ] ፡ መጠውከኒ ፡ ሀበኒ ፡ ቦታኒስ ፡ ወወሀባ ፡ ጎኔትላን
                  ፡ እንተ ፡ ላዕሉ ፡ ወጎኔትላን ፡ እንተ ፡ ታሕቱ ፡ እምርስቶሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ።
verses.translation: And she said to him, Give me a blessing, for thou hast set me in the land of Nageb; give me Botthanis: and he gave her Gonæthla the upper, and Gonæthla the lower.

translations.lxx: And she said to him, Give me a blessing, for thou hast set me in the land of Nageb; give me Botthanis: and he gave her Gonæthla the upper, and Gonæthla the lower.
translations.kjv: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
translations.ron: Iar ea a zis: "Dă-mi binecuvântare. Tu mi-ai dat pământul de la miazăzi; dă-mi şi izvoarele de apă!" Şi i-a dat izvoarele cele de sus şi izvoarele cele de jos.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, δός μοι εὐλογίαν, ὅτι εἰς γῆν Ναγὲβ δέδωκάς με· δός μοι τὴν Βοτθανίς· καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῇ τὴν Γοναιθλὰν τὴν ἄνω καὶ τὴν Γοναιθλὰν τὴν κάτω.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ዘነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አድዋለ ፡ ኤዶም ፡ በገዳሙ ፡ ወቤሴሌኤል ፡
                  ወኣራ ፡ ወአሶር ።
verses.translation: And their cities were cities belonging to the tribe of the children of Juda on the borders of Edom by the wilderness, and Bæseleel, and Ara, and Asor,

translations.lxx: And their cities were cities belonging to the tribe of the children of Juda on the borders of Edom by the wilderness, and Bæseleel, and Ara, and Asor,
translations.kjv: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
translations.ron: Cetăţile care se aflau în partea de miazăzi, la marginea seminţiei fiilor lui Iuda, spre hotarul Edomului, erau: Cabţeel, Eder şi Iagur;
translations.grk: Ἐγενήθησαν δὲ πόλεις αὐτῶν πόλεις πρὸς τῇ φυλῇ υἱῶν Ἰούδα ἐφʼ ὁρίων Ἐδὼμ ἐπὶ τῆς ἐρήμου, καὶ Βαισελεὴλ, καὶ Ἀρὰ, καὶ Ἀσὼρ,

verses.geez: ወኢቀም ፡ ወሬግማ ፡ ወአሩሔል ።
verses.translation: and Icam, and Regma, and Aruel,

translations.lxx: and Icam, and Regma, and Aruel,
translations.kjv: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
translations.ron: China, Dimona şi Adada;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰκὰμ, καὶ Ῥεγμὰ, καὶ Ἀρουὴλ,

verses.geez: ወቃዴስ ፡ ወአስሪዮኔም ፡ ወሚናን ።
verses.translation: and Cades, and Asorionain, and Mænam,

translations.lxx: and Cades, and Asorionain, and Mænam,
translations.kjv: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
translations.ron: Chedeş, Haţor şi Itnan;
translations.grk: καὶ Κάδης, καὶ Ἀσοριωναὶν, καὶ Μαινὰμ,

verses.geez: ወ[በ]ልማናን ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Balmænan, and their villages,

translations.lxx: and Balmænan, and their villages,
translations.kjv: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
translations.ron: Zif, Telem şi Bealot;
translations.grk: καὶ Βαλμαινὰν, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν,

verses.geez: ወአህጉረ ፡ አሴሮን ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ አሶር ።
verses.translation: and the cities of Aseron, this is Asor,

translations.lxx: and the cities of Aseron, this is Asor,
translations.kjv: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
translations.ron: Haţor-Hadata, Cheriot-Heţron, adică Haţor;
translations.grk: καὶ αἱ πόλεις Ἀσερὼν, αὕτη Ἀσὼρ,

verses.geez: ወሴን ፡ ወሰማዓ ፡ ወሞላዳ ።
verses.translation: and Sen, and Salmaa, and Molada,

translations.lxx: and Sen, and Salmaa, and Molada,
translations.kjv: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
translations.ron: Amam, Şerna şi Molada;
translations.grk: καὶ Σὴν, καὶ Σαλμαὰ, καὶ Μωλαδὰ,

verses.geez: ወሴሪ ፡ ወቤፋላድ ።
verses.translation: and Seri, and Bæphalath,

translations.lxx: and Seri, and Bæphalath,
translations.kjv: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
translations.ron: Haţar-Gada, Heşmon şi Bet-Palet;
translations.grk: καὶ Σερὶ, καὶ Βαιφαλὰθ,

verses.geez: ወኮላሶኤዳ ፡ ወበርሳቤሕ ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Cholaseola, and Beersabee; and their villages, and their hamlets,

translations.lxx: and Cholaseola, and Beersabee; and their villages, and their hamlets,
translations.kjv: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
translations.ron: Haţar-Şual, Beerşeba şi Biziotia, cu împrejurimile şi satele lor;
translations.grk: καὶ Χολασεωλὰ, καὶ Βηρσαβεέ· καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν, καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν,

verses.geez: ባላ ፡ ወባቆብ ፡ ወደብራቲሆን ፡ ወኣሶም ።
verses.translation: Bala and Bacoc, and Asom,

translations.lxx: Bala and Bacoc, and Asom,
translations.kjv: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
translations.ron: Baala, Iim şi Aţem;
translations.grk: Βαλὰ, καὶ Βακὼκ, καὶ Ἀσὸμ,

verses.geez: ወኤለቦሂ[ዳ]ድ ፡ ወቤቴል ፡ ወኤርማ ።
verses.translation: and Elboüdad, and Bæthel, and Herma,

translations.lxx: and Elboüdad, and Bæthel, and Herma,
translations.kjv: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
translations.ron: Eltolad, Chesil şi Horma;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἐλβωϋδὰδ, καὶ Βαιθὴλ, καὶ Ἑρμὰ,

verses.geez: ወሴቄላቅ ፡ ወመከርም ፡ ወሴተነኅ ።
verses.translation: and Sekelac, and Macharim, and Sethennac,

translations.lxx: and Sekelac, and Macharim, and Sethennac,
translations.kjv: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
translations.ron: Ţiclag, Madmana şi Sansana;
translations.grk: καὶ Σεκελὰκ, καὶ Μαχαρὶμ, καὶ Σεθεννὰκ,

verses.geez: ወላቦስ ፡ ወሳሌ ፡ ወኤርሞት ፡ ዕሥራ ፡ ወትስዑ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Labos, and Sale, and Eromoth; twenty-nine cities, and their villages.

translations.lxx: and Labos, and Sale, and Eromoth; twenty-nine cities, and their villages.
translations.kjv: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
translations.ron: Lebaot, Şilhim, Ain şi Rimon; de toate douăzeci şi nouă de cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Λαβὼς, καὶ Σαλὴ, καὶ Ἐρωμώθ· πόλεις εἰκοσιεννέα, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: በውስተ ፡ ሐቅል ፡ አስጣሖል ፡ ወ[ሳ]ራ ፡ ወኣሳ ።
verses.translation: In the plain country Astaol, and Raa, and Assa,

translations.lxx: In the plain country Astaol, and Raa, and Assa,
translations.kjv: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
translations.ron: Iar la şes erau: Eştaol, Ţora, Aşna şi Gatnam;
translations.grk: Ἐν τῇ πεδινῇ Ἀσταὼλ, καὶ Ῥάα, καὶ Ἄσσα.

verses.geez: ወራሜን ፡ እንተ ፡ ላዕሉ ፡ ወኢዱቶት ፡ ወመሐንስ ።
verses.translation: and Ramen, and Tano, and Iluthoth, and Mæani,

translations.lxx: and Ramen, and Tano, and Iluthoth, and Mæani,
translations.kjv: And Zanoah, and Engannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
translations.ron: Zanuah, En-Ganim, Tapuah şi Enam;
translations.grk: Καὶ Ῥάμεν, καὶ Τανὼ, καὶ Ἰλουθὼθ, καὶ Μαιανὶ,

verses.geez: ወኤርሙት ፡ ወኦዶለም ፡ ወሜምራ ፡ ወሰኦኮ ፡ ወሐዜቃ ።
verses.translation: and Jermuth, and Odollam, and Membra, and Saocho, and Jazeca.

translations.lxx: and Jermuth, and Odollam, and Membra, and Saocho, and Jazeca.
translations.kjv: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
translations.ron: Iarmut, Adulam, Memvra, Soco şi Azeca;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰερμοὺθ, καὶ Ὀδολλὰμ, καὶ Μεμβρὰ, καὶ Σαωχὼ, καὶ Ἰαζηκὰ,

verses.geez: ወሰቃርም ፡ ወገዴራ ፡ ወ[ደብራቲ]ሃ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወአርባዕ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: And Sacarim and Gadera, and its villages; fourteen cities, and their villages;

translations.lxx: And Sacarim and Gadera, and its villages; fourteen cities, and their villages;
translations.kjv: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Şaaraim, Aditaim, Ghedera şi Ghederotaim; paisprezece cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Σακαρὶμ, καὶ Γάδηρα, καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῆς· πόλεις δεκατέσσαρες, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ሴና ፡ ወአዳሳን ፡ ወመገድገድ ።
verses.translation: Senna, and Adasan, and Magadalgad,

translations.lxx: Senna, and Adasan, and Magadalgad,
translations.kjv: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
translations.ron: Ţenan, Hadaşa şi Migdal-Gad;
translations.grk: Σεννὰ, καὶ Ἀδασὰν, καὶ Μαγαδαλγὰδ,

verses.geez: ወአዳለል ፡ ወመ[ስ]ፋ ፡ ወይቃሬል ፡ ወማኬሳ ።
verses.translation: and Dalad, and Maspha, and Jachareel,

translations.lxx: and Dalad, and Maspha, and Jachareel,
translations.kjv: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
translations.ron: Dilean, Miţpe şi Iocteel;
translations.grk: καὶ Δαλὰδ, καὶ Μασφὰ, καὶ Ἰαχαρεὴλ,

verses.geez: ወቦሴዶት ፡ ወይዴሓ ፡ ዶሌያ ።
verses.translation: and Basedoth, and Ideadalea;

translations.lxx: and Basedoth, and Ideadalea;
translations.kjv: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
translations.ron: Lachiş, Boţcat şi Eglon;
translations.grk: καὶ Βασηδὼθ, καὶ Ἰδεαδαλέα, καὶ

verses.geez: ወኮብራ ፡ ወማክስ ፡ ወመሐኮስ ።
verses.translation: and Chabra, and Maches, and Maachos,

translations.lxx: and Chabra, and Maches, and Maachos,
translations.kjv: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
translations.ron: Cabon, Lahmas şi Chitliş;
translations.grk: Χαβρά, καὶ Μαχὲς, καὶ Μααχὼς,

verses.geez: ወጌዶር ፡ ወቦጋዲየል ፡ ወኖማን ፡ ወመቄደም ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወስሱ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Geddor, and Bagadiel, and Noman, and Machedan: sixteen cities, and their villages;

translations.lxx: and Geddor, and Bagadiel, and Noman, and Machedan: sixteen cities, and their villages;
translations.kjv: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Ghederot, Bet-Dagon, Naama şi Macheda; şaisprezece cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Γεδδὼρ, καὶ Βαγαδιὴλ, καὶ Νωμὰν, καὶ Μαχηδάν· πόλεις ἑκκαίδεκα, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ሌምና ፡ ወኤተቅ ፡ ወአኖክ ።
verses.translation: Lebna, and Ithac, and Anoch,

translations.lxx: Lebna, and Ithac, and Anoch,
translations.kjv: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
translations.ron: Libna, Eter şi Aşan;
translations.grk: Λεβνὰ, καὶ Ἰθὰκ, καὶ Ἀνὼχ,

verses.geez: ወአድና ፡ ወናሲብ ።
verses.translation: and Jana, and Nasib,

translations.lxx: and Jana, and Nasib,
translations.kjv: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
translations.ron: Iftah, Aşna şi Neţib;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰανὰ, καὶ Νασὶβ,

verses.geez: ወኢለም ፡ ወአቄዝም ፡ ወበቴሳር ፡ ወኤሎም ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Keilam, and Akiezi, and Kezib, and Bathesar, and Ælom: ten cities, and their villages;

translations.lxx: and Keilam, and Akiezi, and Kezib, and Bathesar, and Ælom: ten cities, and their villages;
translations.kjv: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Cheila, Aczib, Mareşa şi Edom; nouă cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Κεϊλὰμ, καὶ Ἀκιεζὶ, καὶ Κεζὶβ, καὶ Βαθησὰρ, καὶ Αἰλώμ· πόλεις δέκα, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: አቃሮን ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሃ ፡ ወደብራቲሆን ።
verses.translation: Accaron and her villages, and their hamlets:

translations.lxx: Accaron and her villages, and their hamlets:
translations.kjv: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
translations.ron: Ecron cu cetăţile care ţineau de el şi cu satele lui;
translations.grk: Ἀκκαρὼν, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν,

verses.geez: እምነ ፡ አቃሮን ፡ ጌማ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘሀለወ ፡ ቅሩበ ፡ አሴዶት ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: from Accaron, Gemna, and all the cities that are near Asedoth; and their villages.

translations.lxx: from Accaron, Gemna, and all the cities that are near Asedoth; and their villages.
translations.kjv: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
translations.ron: Şi de la Ecron spre mare tot ce se află împrejurul Aşdodului cu satele lui;
translations.grk: ἀπὸ Ἀκκαρὼν Γεμνά· καὶ πᾶσαι ὅσαι εἰσὶ πλησίον Ἀσηδώθ· καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν,

verses.geez:
አሴዬዶት ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሃ ፡ ወ[ደብራቲ]ሃ ፡ ወጋዛ ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሃ ፡ ወደብራቲሃ ፡ እስከ ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወባሕር ፡
                  ዐባይ ፡ ትፈልጦ ።
verses.translation: Asiedoth, and her villages, and her hamlets; Gaza, and its villages and its hamlets as far as the river of Egypt, and the great sea is the boundary.

translations.lxx: Asiedoth, and her villages, and her hamlets; Gaza, and its villages and its hamlets as far as the river of Egypt, and the great sea is the boundary.
translations.kjv: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
translations.ron: Aşdodul şi cetăţile care ţineau de el şi satele lui; Gaza cu cetăţile care ţineau de ea şi satele ei până ia râul Egiptului şi până la Marea cea Mare, care este hotar.
translations.grk: Ἀσιεδὼθ, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῆς· Γάζα, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῆς ἕως τοῦ χειμάῤῥου Αἰγύπτου, καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ἡ μεγάλη διορίζει.

verses.geez: ወአድባረ ፡ ሳሚርሂ ፡ ወኢዬቴር ፡ ወሦካ ።
verses.translation: And in the hill country Samir, and Jether, and Socha,

translations.lxx: And in the hill country Samir, and Jether, and Socha,
translations.kjv: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
translations.ron: Iar în munţi erau: Şamir, Iatir şi Soco;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν τῇ ὀρεινῇ Σαμὶρ, καὶ Ἰεθὲρ, καὶ Σωχὰ,

verses.geez: ወሬና ፡ ወሀገረ ፡ መጽሐፍ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዳቢር ።
verses.translation: and Renna and the city of Letters, this is Dabir;

translations.lxx: and Renna and the city of Letters, this is Dabir;
translations.kjv: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
translations.ron: Dana, Chiriat-Sana, zis şi Debir;
translations.grk: καὶ Ῥεννὰ, καὶ πόλις Γραμμάτων, αὕτη Δαβὶρ,

verses.geez: ወአኖን ፡ ወሴቄማ ፡ ወኤሳማ ።
verses.translation: and Anon, and Es, and Man, and Æsam,

translations.lxx: and Anon, and Es, and Man, and Æsam,
translations.kjv: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
translations.ron: Anab, Eştemo şi Anim;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀνὼν, καὶ Ἒς, καὶ Μὰν, καὶ Αἰσὰμ,

verses.geez: ወጎሶም ፡ ወ[ከ]ሉ ፡ ወ[ከ]ና ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወአሐቲ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Gosom, and Chalu, and Channa, and Gelom: eleven cities, and their villages;

translations.lxx: and Gosom, and Chalu, and Channa, and Gelom: eleven cities, and their villages;
translations.kjv: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Goşen, Holon şi Ghilo: unsprezece cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Γοσὸμ, καὶ Χαλοὺ, καὶ Χαννὰ, καὶ Γηλώμ· πόλεις ἕνδεκα, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ኤሬም ፡ ወሬምና ፡ ወ[ሶ]ማ ።
verses.translation: Ærem, and Remna, and Soma,

translations.lxx: Ærem, and Remna, and Soma,
translations.kjv: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
translations.ron: Anab, Duma şi Eşean;
translations.grk: Αἰρὲμ, καὶ Ῥεμνὰ, καὶ Σομὰ,

verses.geez: ወኢየማይን ፡ ወቤታቁ ፡ ወፋቁሕ ።
verses.translation: and Jemain, and Bæthachu, and Phacua,

translations.lxx: and Jemain, and Bæthachu, and Phacua,
translations.kjv: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
translations.ron: Ianum, Bet-Tapuah şi Afeca;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰεμαῒν, καὶ Βαιθαχοὺ, καὶ Φακουὰ,

verses.geez: ወኤውማ ፡ ወአህጉረ ፡ አርቦቅ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኬብሮን ፡ ወሶሬት ፡ ትስዑ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወደብራቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Euma, and the city Arboc, this is Chebron, and Soraith: nine cities, and their villages:

translations.lxx: and Euma, and the city Arboc, this is Chebron, and Soraith: nine cities, and their villages:
translations.kjv: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Humta, Chiriat-Arba, zisă şi Hebronul şi Ţior; nouă cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Εὐμὰ, καὶ πόλις Ἀρβὸκ, αὕτη ἐστὶ Χεβρὼν, καὶ Σωραίθ· πόλεις ἐννέα, καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: መሖር ፡ ወኬርሜል ፡ ወኦዚብ ፡ ወኢጣን ።
verses.translation: Maor, and Chermel, and Ozib, and Itan,

translations.lxx: Maor, and Chermel, and Ozib, and Itan,
translations.kjv: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
translations.ron: Maon, Carmel, Zif şi Iuta;
translations.grk: Μαὼρ, καὶ Χερμὲλ, καὶ Ὀζὶβ, καὶ Ἰτὰν,

verses.geez: ወኢያሪዬል ፡ ወኢያሪቅም ፡ ወዘቃይን ።
verses.translation: and Jariel, and Aricam, and Zacanaim,

translations.lxx: and Jariel, and Aricam, and Zacanaim,
translations.kjv: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
translations.ron: Izreel, Iocdeam şi Zanuah;
translations.grk: καὶ Ἰαριὴλ, καὶ Ἀρικὰμ, καὶ Ζακαναῒμ,

verses.geez: ወጋባ ፡ ወተምና ፡ ተስዑ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Gabaa, and Thamnatha; nine cities, and their villages;

translations.lxx: and Gabaa, and Thamnatha; nine cities, and their villages;
translations.kjv: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Cain, Ghibeea şi Timna: zece cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Γαβαὰ, καὶ Θαμναθά· πόλεις ἐννέα, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ወአ[ሉ]ዋ ፡ ወቤትሱር ፡ ወጌዶር ።
verses.translation: Ælua, and Bethsur, and Geddon,

translations.lxx: Ælua, and Bethsur, and Geddon,
translations.kjv: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
translations.ron: Halhul, Bet-Ţur şi Ghedor;
translations.grk: Αἰλουὰ, καὶ Βηθσοὺρ, καὶ Γεδδὼν,

verses.geez: ወመገዶት ፡ ወቤተነም ፡ ወኤቴቁም ፡ ስሱ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Magaroth, and Bæthanam, and Thecum; six cities, and their villages;

translations.lxx: Theco, and Ephratha, this is Bæthleem, and Phagor, and Ætan, and Culon, and Tatam, and Thobes, and Carem, and Galem, and Thether, and Manocho: eleven cities, and their villages,
translations.kjv: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Maarat, Bet-Anot şi Eltecon: şase cetăţi cu satele lor. Tecoa, Efrata sau Betleemul, Peor, Etam, Culon, Tatam, Sores, Carem, Galem, Betir şi Manah: unsprezece cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Μαγαρὼθ, καὶ Βαιθανὰμ, καὶ Θεκούμ· πόλεις ἓξ, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν· Θεκὼ, καὶ Ἐφραθὰ, αὕτη ἐστὶ Βαιθλεὲμ, καὶ Φαγὼρ, καὶ Αἰτὰν, καὶ Κουλὸν, καὶ Τατὰμ, καὶ Θωβὴς, καὶ Καρὲμ, καὶ Γαλὲμ καὶ Θεθὴρ, καὶ Μανοχώ· πόλεις ἕνδεκα, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν·

verses.geez:
ቴቆ ፡ ወኤፍራታ ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ልሔም ፡ ወፋጎር ፡ ወኤጣን ፡ ወቁሎን ፡ ወጠጦን ፡ ወሶቤሔ ፡ ወቃሬ ፡
                  ወጋሌም ፡ ወኤቴር ፡ ወመኖኮ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ [ወአሐቲ ፡] አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ። ቃርያት ፡ በዐል ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሀገረ
                  ፡ ኢያርም ፡ ወሶቤታ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወደብራቲሆን ።
verses.translation: Cariathbaal, this is the city of Jarim, and Sotheba: two cities, and their villages:

translations.lxx: Cariathbaal, this is the city of Jarim, and Sotheba: two cities, and their villages:
translations.kjv: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
translations.ron: Chiriat-Baal sau Chiriat-Iearim şi Harabah; două cetăţi cu satele lor şi cu împrejurimile.
translations.grk: Καριαθβαὰλ, αὕτη ἡ πόλις Ἰαρὶμ, καὶ Σωθηβᾶ· πόλεις δύο, καὶ αἱ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ወባልዳጊስ ፡ ወተራበዐም ፡ ወኤሞን ።
verses.translation: and Baddargeis, and Tharabaam, and Ænon;

translations.lxx: and Baddargeis, and Tharabaam, and Ænon;
translations.kjv: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
translations.ron: În pustiu erau: Bet-Araba, Midin şi Secaca;
translations.grk: καὶ Βαδδαργεὶς, καὶ Θαραβαὰμ, καὶ Αἰνὼν,

verses.geez: ወሰኪዮዛን ፡ ወነፍላዛን ፡ ወአህጉሪሆን ፡ ሳለም ፡ ወአቃዴስ ፡ ሰብዑ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ።
verses.translation: and Æochioza, and Naphlazon, and the cities of Sadon, and Ancades; seven cities, and their villages.

translations.lxx: and Æochioza, and Naphlazon, and the cities of Sadon, and Ancades; seven cities, and their villages.
translations.kjv: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
translations.ron: Nibşan, Ir-Melah şi En-Ghedi: şase cetăţi cu satele lor.
translations.grk: καὶ Αἰοχιοζὰ, καὶ Ναφλαζὼν, καὶ αἱ πόλεις Σαδῶν, καὶ Ἀρκάδης· πόλεις ἑπτὰ, καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወኢየቡሴዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ስእንዎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ አጥፍኦቶሙ ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ኢየቡሴዎን
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ እስከ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: And the Jebusite dwelt in Jerusalem, and the children of Juda could not destroy them; and the Jebusites dwelt in Jerusalem to this day.

translations.lxx: And the Jebusite dwelt in Jerusalem, and the children of Juda could not destroy them; and the Jebusites dwelt in Jerusalem to this day.
translations.kjv: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
translations.ron: Dar pe Iebusei, locuitorii Ierusalimului, nu i-au putut alunga fiii lui Iuda şi de aceea Iebuseii trăiesc cu fiii lui Iuda în Ierusalim până în ziua de astăzi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ Ἰεβουσαῖος κατῴκει ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰούδα ἀπολέσαι αὐτούς· καὶ κατῴκησαν οἱ Ἰεβουσαῖοι ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης.
